summary: Swaps a prompt icon between keyboard and gamepad the moment the player switches device.
overview: Drop it on an Image showing something like "Press [E] to interact" and it swaps to the gamepad icon the instant the player picks up a controller, and back when they touch the keyboard or mouse — tracked by the shared device monitor, so every prompt in the game switches together.
useCases: Interaction prompts that match the device in hand.
Tutorial hints that stay correct when a controller is connected mid-game.
Any UI showing a button icon.

params.tuning: Auto-found on this GameObject if left empty, which covers the usual case.

gotchas.title: It swaps on the device KIND, not the specific pad
gotchas.body: Keyboard and mouse versus gamepad. Showing Xbox versus PlayStation glyphs is a further step this does not take.
